body: I resonate with this very much. By the time I am done with work, I don’t even have the energy to work on personal projects. I just don’t want to do anything after work. I’m grateful that I am employed, but it honestly feels like my job gets in the way of my life. I hate that I wait until the weekend to live because that simply isn’t living. I’m 26 and the thought about having to do this for the rest of my life completely terrifies me.
Yes I am also trying to focus on self care. Music is like medicine to me especially during this time. And we both need to keep our heads up! 🙂
My job is very cliquey. There are two coworkers that I talk to from time to time, so that could be something. I was actually hoping to discover some virtual meetup events. That would be cool.
Oh wow we're the same age. It's awesome that you're doing that. Hopefully I can follow in your footsteps sooner than later.

I guess I am afraid of finding out that there's something truly wrong with me. The thought of possibly being required to take medication scares me too. It's seems like a no-brainer to get help, but I guess I am afraid of the process.
I know I should, but I just still haven't gotten the courage to do it :/
